verdict.rationale: Requesty ships a first-party MCP Gateway that Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code and any MCP-compatible agent can connect to, with server registration, per-user keys and MCP analytics. However, it is documented as a proxy to external MCP servers, not as an official MCP server exposing Requesty's own capabilities. Missing for 10: evidence of an official MCP server exposing Requesty's own functions (routing, keys, analytics), concrete connection details such as an endpoint or config, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your favorite AI coding assistants to Requesty's MCP Gateway for seamless access to external tools and services. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, and any MCP-compatible tool.
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API
Register new servers, explore available tools, and configure authentication settings.
